cards.title: What is WorkHive?
cards.answer: WorkHive is the University of Cebu South Campus HR system. Its public site and role-based Employee, HR, and Admin portals cover attendance, leave, recruitment, employee records, documents, and notifications. Some modules depend on enabled features.
cards.test: What is WorkHive used for?

cards.title: Who can use WorkHive?
cards.answer: WorkHive has Employee, HR, and Admin portals. The pages available to a user depend on the user's role and enabled features.
train: which types of users are there
cards.test: What are the three WorkHive portals?

cards.title: How do I sign in?
cards.answer: Open Sign In and enter your assigned WorkHive email and password. After sign-in, WorkHive opens the portal for your role. If you cannot sign in, use Forgot Password or contact HR through an official channel. Never send credentials to this assistant.
cards.test: How can a staff member enter WorkHive?

cards.title: How do I reset a password?
cards.answer: On Sign In, choose Forgot Password, enter the email registered to your WorkHive account, and use the time-limited reset link sent to that address. Check your spam folder or contact HR if the message does not arrive. Never share the link or code here.
train: regain access to a WorkHive account
recover access after forgetting a login
cards.test: Where is password recovery?

cards.title: Where can I see job openings?
cards.answer: Open the public Careers page to browse job postings. You can search or filter by department and posting status, then open a posting to read its details and qualifications. Check the posting itself for current availability.
cards.test: How can applicants find posted jobs?

cards.title: How does an applicant apply?
cards.answer: On Careers, open an active posting and select Apply. Complete the application form and upload each required document shown there, then submit. The page confirms a successful submission; this assistant cannot submit an application or check its status.
train: how to apply for a job
send an application for an advertised opening
cards.test: What steps are shown for applying to a WorkHive posting?

cards.title: What is on the employee dashboard?
cards.answer: The Employee Dashboard summarizes the signed-in employee's attendance and leave information and links to Clock In/Clock Out, My Profile, File a Leave, and other available pages. This assistant cannot see those personal summaries.
cards.test: What can an employee open from their dashboard?

cards.title: How do employees record attendance?
cards.answer: In the Employee portal, open Clock In/Clock Out. Use Clock In to start a shift, Lunch Out and Lunch In when offered, and End Shift to finish. The page shows today's timeline and a weekly summary. Location checks may apply under campus settings.
cards.test: Where does an employee log time in or out?

cards.title: Can employees use QR attendance?
cards.answer: The current Employee portal does not expose a QR Attendance page. Its active attendance page is Clock In/Clock Out. Some older page content mentions QR attendance, but do not rely on that as an available workflow.
train: use qr code to log attendance
cards.test: Is QR attendance available in WorkHive?

cards.title: Where can employees view attendance history?
cards.answer: Open Attendance History in the Employee portal to review your own saved time records. This assistant cannot view or confirm any person's attendance entries.
cards.test: Which page shows an employee's saved attendance records?

cards.title: How do employees file leave?
cards.answer: Open File a Leave in the Employee portal. Choose a leave type, enter the dates and reason, attach a supporting file if needed, and submit. The form checks date rules and available credits; the submitted request goes to HR for review.
cards.test: Where does an employee send a leave request?

cards.title: Where can employees check a leave request?
cards.answer: Open File a Leave to see your submitted requests and their Pending, Approved, or Disapproved status. Open a request for the HR decision and any remarks. This assistant cannot check a particular request.
cards.test: Which page shows the status of filed leave?

cards.title: Where can employees see leave credits?
cards.answer: The File a Leave page shows the signed-in employee's remaining leave credits by leave type. The assistant cannot retrieve a person's balance or tell whether a specific request will be approved.
cards.test: Where does WorkHive display leave credits?

cards.title: How do employees update a profile?
cards.answer: Open My Profile in the Employee portal to view your details and edit fields the page allows. Save Changes when finished. Contact HR through an official channel about records you cannot correct there.
cards.test: Where can staff update allowed profile fields?

cards.title: How do employees upload documents?
cards.answer: Open Documents / Certificates in the Employee portal, then choose Upload Document. Select the document type and file required by the page. This assistant cannot receive, inspect, or store employee files.
train: upload certificates to the employee portal
place a diploma in WorkHive documents
cards.test: Which WorkHive page handles employee document uploads?

cards.title: Where are notifications?
cards.answer: Open Notifications in the Employee portal to see notices for your signed-in account. You can filter the list and mark notices as read in the portal. This assistant cannot read your notices.
cards.test: Where should an employee check WorkHive notices?

cards.title: Where is the holiday calendar?
cards.answer: WorkHive provides a Holiday Calendar in the employee and HR portals. Check the calendar for the current dates and details; the assistant does not have live calendar data.
cards.test: Which page lists holidays?

cards.title: What is the Employee Master List?
cards.answer: Authorized HR staff use Employee Master List to search and filter employee records, add an employee, and import or export Excel workbooks. Import first shows a preview and duplicate warnings before HR confirms the save. Employee details stay in the protected portal.
cards.test: What is the HR master list for?

cards.title: What does the Attendance Report do?
cards.answer: Authorized HR staff use Attendance Report to review time records, overtime, and filters. Excel import extracts a preview, identifies unmatched or flagged rows and duplicates, then requires confirmation; flagged rows go to Attendance Validation. Export uses the selected date range and filters.
cards.test: What is the HR attendance reporting page used for?

cards.title: What is Attendance Validation?
cards.answer: Attendance Validation is the HR queue for flagged attendance entries, such as unmatched employees or incomplete punches. Authorized staff can filter issues and resolve supported cases in the protected portal.
cards.test: Where does HR review flagged attendance entries?

cards.title: What is the Attendance Summary?
cards.answer: Attendance Summary gives HR a summarized view of attendance by the available filters. Open the protected HR page for current totals; this assistant has no live records.
cards.test: Which HR page shows attendance summaries?

cards.title: What is Tardiness Monitoring?
cards.answer: Tardiness Monitoring lets authorized HR staff review late-arrival patterns and related attendance records. This assistant cannot identify or assess individual employees.
cards.test: Where does HR review late attendance?

cards.title: What does Leave Management do?
cards.answer: In Leave Management, HR reviews employee leave requests and can approve or disapprove them. A disapproval requires a reason, and the employee can see the decision and remarks in File a Leave. Leave Summary Remaining reports credits in the protected HR portal.
cards.test: How does HR handle leave in WorkHive?

cards.title: How does HR manage recruitment?
cards.answer: HR creates and manages openings in Job Postings. Applicants submit through public Careers; HR reviews them in Job Applications and moves them through New, Screening, Interview, Offer, Hired, or Rejected. Interview Scheduling, Interview Result, and Video Conferencing support the interview stage.
train: how does the hiring pipeline work
cards.test: Which HR modules support hiring?

cards.title: What is the Reports Hub?
cards.answer: The HR Reports Hub combines attendance, leave, recruitment, and other available HR summaries for authorized staff. Open that protected page for current figures; this assistant cannot retrieve report data.
cards.test: Where do HR staff open reports?

cards.title: What can administrators manage?
cards.answer: The Admin portal provides System Settings, Feature Toggles, GPS Attendance Zones, User & Role Management, Email Templates, and Audit Log. Only authorized administrators can use these controls.
cards.test: What tools are in WorkHive Admin?

cards.title: What are feature toggles?
cards.answer: Administrators use Feature Toggles to enable or disable supported modules. A disabled module can be hidden from the portal, so page availability may differ by configuration and role.
cards.test: Who controls enabled WorkHive features?

cards.title: What are GPS zones?
cards.answer: Administrators use GPS Attendance Zones to configure location checks for attendance when GPS verification is enabled. Employees may need to pass those checks to record a clock action. This assistant does not reveal zone settings.
cards.test: What are geofence zones used for?

cards.title: What information does WorkHive handle?
cards.answer: The public Privacy Policy explains what WorkHive collects, why it is processed, who can access it, and how to make a privacy request. WorkHive handles employee, applicant, attendance, leave, document, account, and audit information. This assistant has no access to those records.
train: how does workhive use personal information
cards.test: Where does WorkHive explain its data practices?

cards.title: How do I ask about my personal data?
cards.answer: Read the public Privacy Policy and submit a written or documented personal-data request to the HR Office through an official channel. This assistant cannot verify identity or process a records request.
cards.test: How should someone request access to their own WorkHive data?

cards.title: What is on the HR dashboard?
cards.answer: The HR dashboard shows attendance, leave, and recruitment summary cards for authorized HR staff. Open the relevant HR module for the underlying records.
train: what is on the hr home page
cards.test: What does the HR dashboard summarize?

cards.title: Where can an employee see job applications?
cards.answer: The current Employee portal does not expose a My Applications page. A public Careers application shows a submission confirmation; for a personal application-status question, use an official HR contact channel. This assistant cannot look up applicant records.
cards.test: Where are an employee's job applications shown?

cards.title: How does HR schedule interviews?
cards.answer: HR uses Interview Scheduling to book or reschedule an applicant interview, choose onsite or online mode, and enter the time and interviewer details. The page checks for past times and overlapping schedules; online meetings receive a private link when saved.
train: book an interview meeting with applicants
cards.test: Which HR page arranges interviews?

cards.title: Where are interview results managed?
cards.answer: Authorized interviewers use Interview Result to view or edit saved interview evaluations for interviews assigned to them. HR reviews the report before moving an applicant to the next stage. Scores and outcomes remain private.
cards.test: Which page handles interview scoring?

cards.title: What is the Video Conferencing page?
cards.answer: The HR Video Conferencing page supports online interviews scheduled for the signed-in HR moderator. Meeting and guest links belong in the protected recruitment workflow; this assistant cannot access a session.
cards.test: Where does HR conduct online interviews?

cards.title: What is User and Role Management?
cards.answer: Authorized administrators use User & Role Management to manage WorkHive accounts and roles. The assistant cannot create accounts, change permissions, or disclose user records.
cards.test: Which admin page manages roles?

cards.title: What are Email Templates?
cards.answer: Authorized administrators manage system message templates in the Email Templates page. Actual recipient details and sent messages remain outside this assistant.
cards.test: Where are WorkHive email templates managed?

cards.title: What is the Audit Log?
cards.answer: The Admin Audit Log is for authorized review of recorded system actions. Its entries may contain sensitive information, so the assistant does not read or summarize them.
cards.test: Which page shows recorded system actions?
